Cluster initiation zones by heterogeneity metrics

Source: R/iz_heterogeneity_downstream.R
cluster_iz_heterogeneity.Rd

Metrics are winsorised (1%-99%), median-imputed and scaled, then clustered with k-means for every k in k_range; k defaults to the value with the highest mean silhouette width (computed on at most silhouette_n IZs). Ward hierarchical clustering cut at k and a PCA are returned as well.

Usage

cluster_iz_heterogeneity(
  iz_summary,
  metrics,
  k_range = 2:8,
  k = NULL,
  nstart = 50L,
  silhouette_n = 2000L,
  seed = 1L
)

Arguments

iz_summary

Per-IZ table with IZ_id and the metric columns (e.g. assemble_iz_summary()).

metrics

Metric column names.

k_range

Candidate numbers of clusters.

k

NULL or the number of clusters to use (must be in k_range).

nstart

nstart of stats::kmeans().

silhouette_n

Maximum number of IZs used for silhouettes.

seed

Seed for the subsampling and k-means.

Value

A list with assignments, profiles (metric means per cluster), diagnostics, z, centers, hclust, pca, k and metrics.
